name: prepare
doc: The prepare step: a folder of the player's own game files becomes what the runtime starts (code modules with their cuts applied, a RomFS device over the folder, the game's profile). One instance per prepare run. The five stages run in order; each ends with Done (it did its work) or Skip (the manifest holds its output for the same input hash). Fail and Cancel leave any stage; Start from Idle, or again from Ready, Failed or Cancelled (a resume: the stages already done are skipped by their hashes, and a stage to redo has had its manifest record removed). Failed carries the reason. Progress is this state plus the counters of the module (prep_count), never text.
